say:1:1029204001:1.text: Enough! Please stop beating me up! I'll talk, I'll tell you everything!
say:1:1029204001:1.source_cn: 好了好了别打了！我说我说，我什么都说！

choice_prompt:2:1029204001.text: Enough! Please stop beating me up! I'll talk, I'll tell you everything!
choice_prompt:2:1029204001.source_cn: 好了好了别打了！我说我说，我什么都说！

say:3:1029204002:1.text: You... How can you be even scarier than that battle freak?!
say:3:1029204002:1.source_cn: 你……你怎么比那个粗鲁的战斗狂还可怕！
say:3:1029204002:1.male: You... How can you be even scarier than that battle freak?!
say:3:1029204002:1.female: You... How can you be even scarier than that battle freak?!

say:4:1029204003:1.text: I just wanted to take it easy... I'm not even getting paid; who'd wanna stay here?!
say:4:1029204003:1.source_cn: 我只是想偷懒而已……都发不出来工钱了，谁还愿意待在这里！

say:5:1029204004:1.text: This training is exhausting and painful. If I'd known, I'd have gone together with them!
say:5:1029204004:1.source_cn: 参加这个破特训，又累又难受。早知道，就跟他们一起走了！

choice_prompt:6:1029204004.text: This training is exhausting and painful. If I'd known, I'd have gone together with them!
choice_prompt:6:1029204004.source_cn: 参加这个破特训，又累又难受。早知道，就跟他们一起走了！

say:7:1029204005:1.text: Oh, my big mouth... You can't breathe a word to anyone else, but those guys who escaped...
say:7:1029204005:1.source_cn: 唉，我这个破嘴……你不要跟其他人乱说，其实是那几个逃跑...
say:7:1029204005:1.male: Oh, my big mouth... You can't breathe a word to anyone else, but those guys who escaped...
say:7:1029204005:1.female: Oh, my big mouth... You can't breathe a word to anyone else, but those guys who escaped...

say:8:1029204006:1.text: They said a "major deal" had recently come up, and they wanted to go to a secluded place and discuss it in detail.
say:8:1029204006:1.source_cn: 他们说最近有一笔“大生意”，要到一个隐蔽的地方详谈。

say:10:1029204007:2.text: "Major deal"? That sounds suspicious. What exactly do they want to do?
say:10:1029204007:2.source_cn: “大生意”？听着就很可疑，他们到底是做什么去了？

say:11:1029204008:2.text: I-I don't know! If I did, don't you think I would have gone with them?
say:11:1029204008:2.source_cn: 这，这我可就不知道了啊！我要是知道，早就和他们一起溜出去了！

say:12:1029204009:1.text: Before they left, they wanted me to help cover for them, saying they'd share the profits later...
say:12:1029204009:1.source_cn: 他们走之前还让我们帮忙掩护，说是后面有好处会和大家一起分……

say:13:1029204010:2.text: Damn, I should never have believed their rubbish. We're obviously the only ones left to take the beatings...
say:13:1029204010:2.source_cn: 可恶，我就不该信那几个人的鬼话，结果明明只有我们留下来...

say:15:1029204011:2.text: Come clean—what else do you know?!
say:15:1029204011:2.source_cn: 你老实交代，还有没有别的信息！

say:16:1029204012:1.text: I've already told you everything! There's nothing else, really! Listen, go ask Rofis; he knows more!
say:16:1029204012:1.source_cn: 我已经把我知道的事情都告诉你了啊！再多就真的没有了！嗯...

choice:2:0:1.text: What do you have to say?
choice:2:0:1.male: What do you have to say?
choice:2:0:1.female: What do you have to say?
